must_identify.item: New api pods are stuck in Init:0/1 because the init container wait-for-db never completes
must_identify.evidence: New ReplicaSet api-77b4b6956f (revision 2) has 1 pod, api-77b4b6956f-gstww, stuck in Init:0/1 for ~80s and counting — looping forever on nc -z postgres 5432 since the init container's own logs show waiting for postgres:5432 and the DNS target doesn't resolve to any backend.

must_identify.item: It waits for postgres:5432, and no Service named postgres exists in namespace shop
must_identify.evidence: No postgres Service or endpoint exists anywhere in the cluster (checked namespace shop and cluster-wide — only api, frontend, redis services exist, no postgres pods/service in any namespace).

wrong_answers_asserted: Creating a postgres database as the fix without noting the api does not need one
notes: The diagnosis is fully correct. Option 2 (remove the init container or roll back) is acceptable. Reviewers should also check the 'cluster-wide' claim, since the listed commands only show 'kubectl get svc -n shop' (they may be truncated).
